Encoded as dessin/1: 8 edges around the cycle, black = 0 (strokes), white = 1 (points); 4 black and 4 white vertices of degree 2, two faces of degree 4, genus 0 -- the dessin of a degree-8 map with two poles of order 4 (like z^4 + z^-4). The marks are placed at even spacing; on the page they are spaced unevenly. The typed show-through at the bottom is ignored.
